front.title: YANG Model for BGP Flow Specification

abstract.t: This document defines a YANG data model for the BGP Flow Specification (Flowspec) address families. The model augments the BGP YANG model to add all Flow Specification address families, including Flowspec-specific configuration, the Flow Specification RIB, and per-neighbor Adj-RIBs, and defines notifications for the prefix limit exceeded and route state change events.
